extracted.intended_audience: European Patent Office examiners, patent attorneys, and applicants preparing or prosecuting European patent applications
extracted.subtask_description: Table of contents for the EPO 'Guidelines for Examination' (June 2012) covering formalities, search, substantive examination, opposition, procedural matters, the patent application, patentability, and amendments/corrections. The page enumerates the topics and evaluation/processing dimensions used by the EPO during prosecution and post-grant procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing of applications and examination on filing
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and checks to be carried out at filing and immediate examination on filing of a European patent application (Part A, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; full procedural requirements and checklists provided in the Guidelines (see Part A - Chapter II).

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of formal requirements of the application (documents, signatures, formal compliance) before substantive processing (Part A, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; detailed formal requirements and corrective measures described in Part A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special provisions (formalities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Special formal provisions that apply in particular cases or for specific applicant categories (Part A, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; see Part A for examples and exceptions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicating the formalities report; amendment of application; correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO communicates formalities defects, how applicants may amend applications and correct formal errors (Part A, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes timing, form of communications, and procedures for corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of application; request for examination and transmission of the dossier to Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on publication, the request for substantive examination, and transfer of the dossier to the Examining Division (Part A, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; procedural timelines and effects outlined in Part A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Language requirements for proceedings, language of the application, translations and derogations (Part A, Chapter VII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; contains rules on acceptable languages and translation obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common provisions (formalities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Common rules and cross-cutting formal provisions applicable across formalities examination (Part A, Chapter VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; see Part A for general principles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Drawings
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive requirements for drawings submitted with a European patent application (Part A, Chapter IX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes format, legibility, and correction rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fees
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules on payment of fees, fee types, timing, and effects of non-payment (Part A, Chapter X).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; detailed fee tables and legal consequences provided in Part A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inspection of files; communication of information contained in files; consultation of the Register of European Patents; issuance of certified copies
rubrics_metrics.description: Access to file documents, information disclosure, register consultation and issuance of certified copies (Part A, Chapter XI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; procedural and confidentiality rules set out in Part A.

rubrics_metrics.name: Characteristics of the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Qualitative and quantitative characteristics that a proper EPO search should meet (Part B, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; see Part B for performance standards and expected coverage of searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search procedure and strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Practical procedure and strategic approach for carrying out prior-art searches (Part B, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes search scope, databases, and search logic guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preclassification (routing) and official classification of European patent applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Routing of applications and assignment of official classifications prior to or during the search (Part B, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; explains classification systems and routing practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: The state of the art at the search stage
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and assessment of the relevant state of the art for the purposes of the search (Part B, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; clarifies what counts as prior art at the search stage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (search stage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity for the purposes of the search and possible partial searches (Part B, Chapter VII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; guidance on detecting lack of unity and effect on search scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject-matter to be excluded from the search
rubrics_metrics.description: Types of subject-matter the EPO excludes from search (e.g., non-technical aspects) (Part B, Chapter VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; examples and exclusion criteria given in Part B.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search documentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Documentation and sources to be recorded or cited in the search (Part B, Chapter IX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes citation practices and record-keeping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search report
rubrics_metrics.description: Content and structure of the EPO search report (Part B, Chapter X).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; describes required elements and formatting of the report.

rubrics_metrics.name: The search opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Form and substance of the EPO's search opinion accompanying the search report (Part B, Chapter XI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; explains purpose and typical content of the opinion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formal requirements to be met before the Division starts substantive examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal prerequisites that must be satisfied before substantive examination begins (Part C, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; lists conditions such as timely payment, translations, and requests for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: The first stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial substantive assessment steps taken by the Examining Division at the start of examination (Part C, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes search-result consideration and identification of issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of replies and further stages of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: How the EPO examines applicant replies and conducts subsequent examination stages (Part C, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; covers timing, admissibility of amendments, and iterative communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: The final stage of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Criteria and procedures for concluding substantive examination and issuing decisions (Part C, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes grant decisions, refusals and finalisation steps.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits and acceleration of examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicable time limits during examination and options/procedures to accelerate processing (Part C, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; describes targets, extensions, and accelerated prosecution mechanisms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Other procedures in examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Miscellaneous procedures that may arise during substantive examination (Part C, Chapter VII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; catch-all for special procedural measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Work within the Examining Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Organisation and internal procedures of Examining Divisions (Part C, Chapter VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; addresses division composition, workload allocation and internal practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Special applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Particular categories of applications requiring special treatment (e.g., emergency or sensitive applications) (Part C, Chapter IX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; examples and special workflows provided in the Guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Role, composition and general functioning of the Opposition Division (Part D, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; procedural rules for opposition proceedings are detailed in Part D.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opposition (procedure and requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedural requirements and substantive issues in filing and processing oppositions (Part D, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes admissibility, grounds of opposition, and time limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure up to substantive examination (opposition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Preliminary procedural steps before substantive examination of an opposition (Part D, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; addresses formal checks and preliminary communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantive examination of opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of the substantive grounds of opposition (novelty, inventive step, added subject-matter, etc.) (Part D, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; substantive evaluation standards applied by the Opposition Division.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure for the examination of the opposition
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed procedural steps followed when examining an opposition (Part D, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes hearings, evidence, and decision drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions of the Opposition Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Form, content, and legal effect of decisions issued by the Opposition Division (Part D, Chapter VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; describes annulment, maintenance, or revocation outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Costs (opposition proceedings)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules governing costs and apportionment in opposition proceedings (Part D, Chapter IX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; sets out who bears which costs and under what circumstances.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limitation and revocation procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and criteria for post-grant limitation and revocation of European patents (Part D, Chapter X).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes grounds and formal steps for limitation/revocation requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications and notifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards and modes for official communications and notifications in EPO proceedings (Part E, Chapter I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; covers service methods and legal effects of notifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct, scheduling and evidentiary role of oral proceedings before the EPO (Part E, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes attendance, procedural rights, and language issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Taking and conservation of evidence
rubrics_metrics.description: How evidence is taken, evaluated and preserved in EPO proceedings (Part E, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; rules on admissibility and preservation of documents and testimony.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derogations from the language of the proceedings in oral proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances under which deviating languages may be used in oral proceedings (Part E, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; explains exceptions and procedures for language derogations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination by the EPO of its own motion; facts, evidence or grounds not submitted in due time; observations by third parties
rubrics_metrics.description: EPO powers to examine matters of its own motion, late-filed material rules, and third-party observations (Part E, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; procedural implications and limits detailed in Part E.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interruption and stay of the proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for suspending or staying EPO proceedings and the effects of interruption (Part E, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes grounds for stay and procedural consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Time limits, loss of rights, further and accelerated processing and re-establishment of rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive treatment of time limits, consequences of missing them, acceleration options and reinstatement procedures (Part E, Chapter VII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; critical for procedural compliance—see Part E for deadlines and remedies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications under the Patent Cooperation Treaty (PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: How PCT applications enter and are handled before the EPO (Part E, Chapter VIII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes national phase entry, translations and PCT-specific rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decisions (general procedural matters)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form and content of EPO decisions in various proceedings (Part E, Chapter IX).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes formal requirements and notification of decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appeals
rubrics_metrics.description: Appeal procedures against EPO decisions (Part E, Chapter X).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; covers filing, admissibility, and conduct of appeal proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request from a national court for a technical opinion concerning a European patent
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedure for handling national court requests to the EPO for technical opinions (Part E, Chapter XI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; explains scope and form of EPO technical opinions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registering transfers, licences, other rights, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for registering assignments, licences and other proprietary rights in the EPO register (Part E, Chapter XII).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; administrative steps and evidentiary requirements described in Part E.

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of a European patent application (other than claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Required and recommended content of the description, abstract and other parts of the application (Part F, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes structure, required disclosures and recommended practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist for considering the abstract
rubrics_metrics.description: Checklist items to assess the abstract for compliance and usefulness (Part F-II Annex 1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; provides concrete checklist for drafting the abstract.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units recognised in international practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted units of measurement and notation conforming to Rule 49(11) (Part F-II Annex 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; gives standard units to be used in applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sufficiency of disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the application disclose the invention sufficiently for a skilled person to carry it out (Part F, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; substantive legal standard and examples in Part F.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims (Art. 84 and formal requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal and substantive rules governing claims, clarity and support under Article 84 (Part F, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes examples of essential features and claim drafting standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples concerning essential features
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrative examples to determine which features are essential for the claimed invention (Part F, Chapter IV - Annex).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; practical examples to guide claim interpretation and drafting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of invention (application / claims)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of unity as it relates to the content of the application and claims (Part F, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; guidance on detecting multiple inventions and required claim grouping.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and criteria for claiming priority from earlier applications (Part F, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes priority entitlement and date effects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patentability (general)
rubrics_metrics.description: General criteria and principles determining whether subject-matter is patentable under the EPC (Part G, Chapter I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; overarching patentability framework set out in Part G.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventions (definition and scope)
rubrics_metrics.description: What constitutes an 'invention' for patentability purposes (Part G, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; defines the boundary between patentable subject-matter and excluded categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Industrial application
rubrics_metrics.description: Requirement that the invention be susceptible of industrial application (Part G, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; examples and interpretation guidance in Part G.

rubrics_metrics.name: State of the art (patentability assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition and assessment of the prior art relevant to patentability (Part G, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; explains what constitutes the state of the art and how to apply it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Non-prejudicial disclosures
rubrics_metrics.description: Circumstances where disclosures do not prejudice novelty or inventive step (e.g., grace periods) (Part G, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; sets out criteria and exceptions for non-prejudicial disclosures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment and legal standard for novelty of claimed subject-matter (Part G, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes concepts of single disclosure and prior-art comparison.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of inventive step (non-obviousness) including problem-solution approach and indicators (Part G, Chapter VII and Annex).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; Annex provides examples and indicators to assist inventive-step analysis.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to amend
rubrics_metrics.description: Legal entitlement and limits on who may amend the application and when (Part H, Chapter I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; sets out procedural timing and who can request amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments - general rules
rubrics_metrics.description: General admissibility rules for amendments to applications during prosecution (Part H, Chapter II).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; describes procedural admissibility tests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Admissibility of amendments - other procedural matters
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional procedural aspects affecting admissibility of amendments (Part H, Chapter III).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes interplay with time limits, replies and opposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments - Art. 123(2) and Art. 123(3)
rubrics_metrics.description: Substantive tests for allowability of amendments that add subject-matter or extend protection (Articles 123(2) and 123(3)) (Part H, Chapter IV).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes standards and examples illustrating impermissible and permissible amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Allowability of amendments - examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Concrete examples demonstrating allowability or unallowability of amendments (Part H, Chapter V).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; practical examples to guide decision-making on amendments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Correction of errors
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and standards for correcting errors in applications and granted patents (Part H, Chapter VI).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TOC entry; includes formal and substantive corrections and relevant conditions.
